layout.architecture: 65C816 little-endian 16-bit accumulator mode at these instructions
layout.consumer_mask: CODE_80:DD31 reads word actor+$0013 then masks $000F, therefore it observes the low nibble of byte +$0013

initialization.default_wrapper: CODE_86:8000 explicitly sets Y=$0000 before entering CODE_86:8006
initialization.deduction: the default wrapper initializes the consumed byte +$0013 to zero; direct entry can initialize it from the caller-Y high byte

limitations: This establishes byte overlap and initialization only, not the semantic meaning of Y or the resulting nibble.
Other writers of the byte range remain to be traced before lifecycle or input meaning can be assigned.
No browser behavior is changed from this structural result alone.
